structure: Part 10 of repo:plantsfrontend read, in full, the high-risk plants notification view (check your answers) feature and the review helpers it shares with the notification list. Files read: src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/ — page.js (5 lines), refusal.js (26), controller.js (185), template.njk (114), check-answers.fit.spec.js (443, 21 tests), controller.test.js (963), copy/copy.en.js (140), copy/copy.cy.js (141), copy/copy.test.js (60), view-model/index.js (332), view-model/view-header.js (80), view-model/view-header.test.js (123), view-model/incomplete-cards.js (89), view-model/incomplete-cards.test.js (28), view-model/invalid-parties.js (37), view-model/rows/change-link.js (34), view-model/rows/error-row.js (49), view-model/rows/summary-row.js (26), view-model/rows/value-text.js (21) — and features/review/ — evaluation.js (12), lateness.js (36), lateness.test.js (47), late-rule.js (16), late-rule.test.js (29), notification-day-text.js (10), notification-day-text.test.js (12). Read for context only, claimed by other parts: obligations/sections/review.js (part 12), src/server/app/shared/kit.js (part 13), and, for the wording and values the view-model reads across feature boundaries, features/timing-windows.js, features/arrival-details/copy/copy.en.js (dateLabels), features/place-of-destination/copy/copy.en.js (headings), features/address-book-picker/address-lines.js and services/commodities/index.js (lineFieldsFor). Covered: the one page this slice serves, slug 'notification-view', with GET and POST; its header for a draft and a submitted notification (reference as H1, status tag, date line, Amend and Delete buttons, the import reference numbers section with its warning and the customs document code); the 'Check your answers' H1 and journey strip an amendment gets instead; its three numbered sections and every card and summary row on them (import details, one card per commodity line, arrival details, place of destination, consignor, identification numbers, contact), each row's key, its value text and its Change or Edit details link; the lateness warning and the submitted lateness banner; the error summary, the seven incomplete-card messages and the three party-error messages, what makes a party invalid, what refuses Continue and what it logs; the page foot (submit heading, Continue, save actions, Cancel amend) and the amendment-cancelled banner; every copy key in both locales; the 21 fit tests; and the view-model, view-header and rows/ helpers as mechanism claims. The slice stops before the declaration and confirmation pages, which part 11 claims.
